kind: illustrative numerical conditioning and finite-data simulation; not proof certificates
precision: IEEE float64; tiny rates remain positive, boundary study stops at 1e-12

finite_data.record_sampling: n complete inter-mark intervals after first observed mark; stationary CTMC initialization

optimizer.coordinates: natural logarithms of all six rates

finite_data.interval: pointwise asymptotic martingale-sandwich delta Wald, intersected with [0,infinity)
finite_data.interior_screen: successful optimum; all rates in [10*lower,0.999*upper]; smin(Jlog)>1e-12*smax(Jlog)
finite_data.rare_mark_screen: suppress suggested delta interval when either observed same-mark count is below 20; heuristic only, not a finite-sample coverage guarantee
